body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Sharp displayed its 32-inch full HD LCD TV ‘GP3U series’ for gaming enthusiasts at CES 2008.
The 32-inch TV is available in three glossy finish colors, black (LC-32GP3U-B), dark wine red (LC-32GP3U-R) and white (LC-32GP3U-W).

The GP3U series, newly outfitted in a slim body with a unique swivel stand, includes specialized features that enhance the game-playing experience, including a Game Mode that optimizes the picture quality for game-playing, and a custom-designed remote control that allows gamers quick access to the side-terminal inputs. These models also include Vyper Drive game mode to eliminate perceptible lag time between game console input and the TV display.

Additionally, the series boasts all the features found on Sharp’s traditional AQUOS sets, including 1920 x 1080 Advanced Super View Panel with a 4-wavelength backlight system, for deeper, more vivid reds, as well as an impressive 10,000:1 dynamic contrast ratio for deep blacks and crisp picture quality.

Sharp’s entire AQUOS line was designed by world-renowned industrial designer Toshiyuki Kita, whose designs are on display at the Museum of Modern Art in New York. The AQUOS brand evokes images of liquid crystal fluidity and emphasizes the elegant design and superior performance consumers have come to expect from Sharp products.
